guard/30121.htm.text: Captain Jeronin: Welcome, foreign traveler. I am Captain Jeronin. Under Sir Ortho Lancer, I train the guards and maintain the peace of the village. Our village is a trade center, and many people come and go. Because of that, great pains are taken to maintain public peace.

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
